per_answer.verdict: Half of a correct answer. The E4-for-the-unit move is right and well-cited (t1090, t1243, Issue 312 all check out). But A never introduces any time-sliced construct for the mill's own membership -- no E93, no P164 -- so the 'administrative membership... whichever unit applied at the time' is asserted in prose with no CRM construct actually carrying the 'at the time' qualifier; it depends on this case's membership window happening to coincide with each unit's own existence window, a coincidence the answer never flags. It cites t1090 but not the second half of Doerr's own reply there ('P161, E93, P164... cover all cases'), which is exactly the guidance it needed and did not follow. B and C are very close on the core question -- near-indistinguishable there -- and separate only on the secondary naming sub-problem, where C's E7 Activity + P16 (grounded in the verified text of Issue 147) is the more specifically-attested SIG answer to dated vernacular name usage than B's E15 Identifier Assignment route, and C closes with a sharper reframing of the question itself.
